## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`), electron and hole side

Raw R(B) first, then the SdH read (onsets + FFT in 1/B). Landed at the 2026-08-23 pickup — the runs completed just before the handoff and their analysis had not been landed. Model anchors from the step-2 feasibility table: at n = +3.2×10¹² the total (4-fold) frequency budget is F_tot = 33.1 T — ABAB partitions it ≈ 7.5 + 25.6 T (light + heavy bilayer-like bands), ABCA carries it in a single 33.1 T tone; at n = −1.2×10¹², F_tot = 12.4 T, ABAB pair ≈ 5.3/7.1 T.

"""Runs 6-7 raw: sdh-spot-check R(B) at D = 0, electron (run 6, n=+3.2e12, 0->10 T) and
hole (run 7, n=-1.2e12, 10->0.3 T ride-down), sr1 50 uV, I ~ 10 nA."""
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, current_channel

def load_spot(rid):
    r = run(rid)
    B = r.col("magnet_field")
    chs = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    cur = current_channel(list(chs.values()))
    I = r.col(cur.col) / cur.gain
    R = (r.col("sr1_X") / chs["sr1"].gain) / I
    srt = np.argsort(B)
    return B[srt], np.abs(R[srt]), np.abs(I[srt]), r

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13, 4.5))
for a, (rid, tag) in zip(ax, [(6, "electron n = +3.2e12"), (7, "hole n = -1.2e12")]):
    B, R, I, r = load_spot(rid)
    print(summarize_run(r))
    print(f"run {rid}: R {R.min():.0f}-{R.max():.0f} Ohm, I {I.mean()*1e9:.2f} nA, "
          f"full scale {50e-6/I.mean():.0f} Ohm (max R {100*R.max()*I.mean()/50e-6:.0f}% FS)\n")
    a.plot(B, R, lw=0.6)
    a.set_xlabel("B (T)"); a.set_ylabel("|Rxx| (Ohm)"); a.set_title(f"run {rid} — {tag}, D = 0")
fig.tight_layout()

"""Runs 6-7 SdH content: per-tone onsets (sdh_onset) + FFT in 1/B (sdh_fft), against the
step-2 model anchors: e-side total F = 33.1 T (ABAB pair ~7.5/25.6, ABCA single 33.1);
h-side total 12.4 T (ABAB pair ~5.3/7.1, ABCA LK-dead)."""
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError

MODEL = {6: [("F_tot 33.1", 33.1, "r"), ("ABAB 7.5", 7.5, "g"), ("ABAB 25.6", 25.6, "g")],
         7: [("F_tot 12.4", 12.4, "r"), ("ABAB 5.3", 5.3, "g"), ("ABAB 7.1", 7.1, "g")]}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13, 4.5))
for a, rid in zip(ax, (6, 7)):
    B, R, I, r = load_spot(rid)
    try:
        o = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=50e-6 / I.mean())
        print(f"=== run {rid} ===\n{o.summary()}\n")
    except SdhOnsetError as e:
        print(f"=== run {rid} === sdh_onset FAILED: {e}\n")
    for blo, ls in [(1.5, "-"), (3.0, "--")]:
        sel = B >= blo
        f, s = sdh_fft(R[sel][:, None], B[sel])
        a.plot(f, s[0] / s[0].max(), ls, lw=0.8, label=f"B {blo:.1f}-10 T")
    for lab, F, c in MODEL[rid]:
        a.axvline(F, color=c, ls=":", lw=0.8)
        a.text(F, 1.02, lab, rotation=90, fontsize=6, ha="center", va="bottom", color=c)
    a.set_xlim(0, 60); a.set_xlabel("F (T)"); a.set_ylabel("FFT mag (norm)")
    a.set_title(f"run {rid} SdH FFT in 1/B"); a.legend(fontsize=7)
fig.tight_layout()

**Read (runs 6–7):** Strong SdH on both sides; nothing rails (≤ 12 % FS at 50 µV) and no leakage. **Electron side (run 6, n = +3.2×10¹², F_tot = 33.1 T):** a dominant light tone F ≈ 7.1 T alive from the 0.3 T record edge, with a harmonic ladder at 14.1 / 22.2 / 29.5 T, **plus** FFT weight at 25.7 T in the 3–10 T window. The light-band bookkeeping is self-consistent with a two-band 4-fold partition: n_light = 7.1/10.34 = 0.69×10¹² leaves n_heavy = 2.51×10¹² → F_heavy = 26.0 T, i.e. exactly the 25.7 T weight — matching the ABAB prediction (7.5 + 25.6 T) — but at a single density the 22–30 T weight cannot be split between 7.1 T harmonics (3× = 21.3, 4× = 28.4) and a genuine heavy fundamental; ABCA's single 33.1 T tone is disfavored (no weight at 33) though a soft read. Additional low tones 3.0/4.2/5.2 T persist to the record edge — candidates: mosaic region B (run 5: +0.43×10¹² offset), magneto-intersubband/difference frequencies, or a third pocket. **Hole side (run 7, n = −1.2×10¹², F_tot = 12.4 T):** multi-tone (4.7, 6.6, 8.5, 12.3 T, the last with the highest SNR ≈ F_tot) — the near-CNP low-|n| regime the recipe flags; not decisive by itself. **Consequence:** the discriminating measurement is the Landau fan at D = 0 — per-column FFT gives F(n) for every tone; harmonics ride at k×F_light(n), a real heavy band has its own slope and a band-edge onset, and the partition slopes read the per-band degeneracy directly. → plan step 4.

## HERA — Step 4 (plan): Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`) — the stacking-call dataset

> **05:27** · landau-fan: D=0 line (run-5 cal), n -1.26..+3.24e12 fast 91 pts (dn 0.05e12), B 0.5->10 T slow 220 rows uniform-1/B ascending, sr1 100 uV, leak trip 1 nA; ends at 10 T, gates parked 0 · **ETA ~14:27** (≈9h)

Operator-requested next move; plan step 4. Runs 6–7 (ana cells 14–17) found strong SdH on both carrier signs but a single-density read can't split the electron side's 22–30 T weight between harmonics of the 7.1 T light tone and a genuine heavy band (ABAB predicts 7.5 + 25.6 T; the observed light tone implies F_heavy = 26.0 T — degenerate with 3–4× harmonics). The fan resolves it by slope: per-column FFT gives F(n) for every tone — harmonics ride at k×F_light(n), a real band has its own slope (degeneracy read: dF/dn = h/ge) and a band-edge onset; plus the high-B filling-factor sequence and CNP-gap-vs-B for free. **Geometry:** fast axis = (V_tg, V_bg) co-swept along the calibrated D = 0 line (run 5 cal), n = −1.26 → +3.24×10¹² in 91 pts (Δn = 0.05×10¹²; full validator-limited window both signs, ~3 mV/5 mV margin at the TG ends); slow axis = B, 0.5 → 10 T ascending, 220 rows **uniform in 1/B** (per-column FFT needs no resample; ΔF = 0.53 T full-window, Nyquist 58 T — 2nd harmonic of a 33 T tone folds to 46 T, above every fundamental). Magnet sits at 0 → cheap low-B rows first, ends at 10 T (no re-traverse; T-dependence or D-cuts can ride down). **Sensitivity:** sr1 100 µV (10 kΩ FS) — sized to the map's worst corner per the run-4 lesson; the ν = 0 CNP column may still clip at high B (accepted: gap positions survive, SdH columns keep dynamic range). Coverage trade: hole side reaches only −1.26×10¹² (TG limit) — stated, not fixable in software. **Price:** 69 min ramp floor + 220 rows × (91 × 1.17 s + turnaround) ≈ 8.2 h from run-5-measured per-point timing; with the session's 5–10 % overrun evidence → **~9 h**. **Checkpoints:** first rows (rail/leak/dead channel — kill in the first minutes); then digest reads every ~1–2 h with interim per-column FFT on landed rows — continue/abort call at each (an abort keeps partial rows; the fan is FFT-usable from ~half depth). Preconditions on the page: T base, B ≈ 0, V_si = 0, PS heater/output, NPLC 1. Leak guard trips at 1 nA (flyback transients are ±0.2 nA, run-5 measured).

# === Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`): B slow 0.5 -> 10 T uniform-1/B (220 rows), n fast -1.26 -> +3.24e12 (91 pts) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.linspace(-1.26, 3.24, 91)                     # 1e12 cm^-2, dn = 0.05
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, np.zeros_like(n_vec), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX, (Vtg_vec.min(), Vtg_vec.max())
assert Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vbg_vec.min(), Vbg_vec.max())
print(f"fast axis: n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} .. {n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 at D = 0 -> Vtg [{Vtg_vec.min():+.4f}, {Vtg_vec.max():+.4f}], "
      f"Vbg [{Vbg_vec.min():+.4f}, {Vbg_vec.max():+.4f}] V")

# --- field rows: uniform in 1/B, ascending 0.5 -> 10 T (magnet sits at 0; low-B rows first, cheap ramps) ---
B_vec = np.round(1.0 / np.linspace(1 / 0.5, 1 / 10.0, 220), 4)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0)
print(f"slow axis: {len(B_vec)} rows, B {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T uniform-1/B; "
      f"FFT dF = {1/(1/B_vec[0]-1/B_vec[-1]):.2f} T, Nyquist {len(B_vec)/(2*(1/B_vec[0]-1/B_vec[-1])):.0f} T")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.02), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.02 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not reset to 1"

# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan: 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA (run-5 lesson: size to the map's
# worst corner). Known trade: the nu = 0 CNP column can exceed 10 kOhm at high B and clip — accepted,
# gap positions survive clipping and the SdH columns need the dynamic range.
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
I_TRIP = 1e-9
print(f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V -> ~10 nA; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (10 kOhm FS); tau {sr1.time_constant()} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = ("landau-fan: D = 0 (run-5 cal), n -1.26..+3.24e12 fast (91 pts), B 0.5 -> 10 T uniform-1/B slow (220 rows), "
                  "sr1 100 uV, fast_delay 1.0, slow_delay 3.0")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 line: n {n_vec[0]:+.2f}..{n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 fast 91 pts (dn 0.05); B {B_vec[0]}..{B_vec[-1]} T slow '
              f'220 rows uniform-1/B ascending; cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, '
              f'D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; sr1 100 uV; stacking-call dataset (plan step 4)')
s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg, Vbg (fast bundle), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f}, Vbg={float(data[3]):+.3f}: "
              f"|I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                     slow_delay=3.0, fast_delay=1.0)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
    print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T (left at high field), gates parked at 0: "
          f"(Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}) V")
